svg.title: Recorded workflow evidence index
svg.desc: Observed recorder results, not a prospective design or a Penpot-authored file. Cards contain abbreviated previews; index.html preserves full intent and observations.
svg.text: Recorder state: passed | Evidence index, not a design proposal
Intent: Evaluation pilot, not a production invoice feature: enter repeated synthetic invoice
identifiers, save each identifier once in first-appearance order, open the persisted export,
and reopen it to verify the saved result. Prove the browser-to-HTTP-to-SQLite-to-readback
journey with every step visible. This bounded pilot verifies Deepmode recording and replay, not
the user's entire broader Deepmode improvement request.
Previews abbreviated. Arrows show recording order, not proven causality.
